name: Sprint
description: May attack on the turn it is played.

name: Ranged
description: May attack back-row creatures even while they have a front protector.

name: Shield X
description: Gains X shield when played. Shield absorbs damage before HP.

name: Resilient
description: The first time this creature would take lethal damage each game, it survives with 1 HP instead. Returning it to hand does not reset this protection.

name: Regeneration X
description: Heals X HP at the end of its owner’s turn, up to its maximum HP.

name: Ward X
description: Enters with X Ward counters. Each negative card effect prevented consumes 1 Ward. Ward does not refresh each turn; combat damage and sacrifice costs do not consume Ward.

name: Scorch
description: After dealing combat damage to a creature, apply Burn. Burn deals 2 damage at its next turn start, then clears.

name: Stunning
description: After dealing combat damage to a creature, stun it. Stun skips its next eligible combat; it can still retaliate.

name: Deathburst X
description: When this creature dies, deal X damage to its last attacker, if it is still in play.

name: Packbond
description: When another friendly creature with the same base card dies, this creature gains +1 Attack for the rest of the game.

name: Reflect
description: While shielded, reflect the amount of damage absorbed by shield back to the source creature. Reflected damage cannot reflect again.

name: Stalwart X
description: Gain +X Attack while there is no other friendly creature in this creature’s lane.

name: Ambush
description: May be played during the opponent’s Combat phase, before they declare any attacks.

name: Follow up
description: Attacks twice against the same target.

name: Restore X
description: Heal X HP at the end of each of this creature’s controller’s turns, not at the end of the opponent’s turns.

name: Invisible
description: Cannot be targeted by attacks, Spells or effects. Effects that do not directly target this creature can still affect it.
